question: Read-ahead feeder buffer: how many reader-front slots (K) are worth having on the real trace?
trace: Fujitsu VDI (Lee et al. SYSTOR'17), data/2016022211-LUN0.csv, reads only
policy: B1 (Silica: earliest queued platter, merge same platter), Zone, 8 shuttles fetching in parallel; buffer is FIFO

online.load_note: arrival rate fixed per mapping = load x B1 burst throughput at K=8, so every K sees the same arrivals

knee_rule: smallest K whose mean latency is within 5% of the best K (per mapping and load)
